mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_comments (id, content_type, content_id, parent_id, user_id, content, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{contentType}, #{contentId}, #{parentId}, #{userId}, #{content}, FALSE, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_comments reply WHERE reply.parent_id = c.id AND reply.is_deleted = FALSE) AS reply_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_comment_likes reaction WHERE reaction.comment_id = c.id) AS like_count, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM content_comment_likes reaction WHERE reaction.comment_id = c.id AND reaction.user_id = #{viewerId}) AS has_liked FROM content_comments c WHERE c.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE content_comments SET is_deleted = TRUE, content = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = FALSE
UPDATE content_comments SET content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM content_comment_likes WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND user_id = #{userId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO content_comment_likes(comment_id, user_id) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{userId}) ON CONFLICT (comment_id, user_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM content_comment_likes WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content_comments WHERE content_type = #{contentType} AND content_id = #{contentId} AND is_deleted = FALSE
